title: Ralph blocked-facts ledger
description: Append-only ledger of blocking facts: conformance rows whose required evidence is unavailable (undeclared/unevidenced capability, missing real system, missing hardware, open product defect, or pending human decision) must reference an open fact here. Facts are never deleted, reordered, or renumbered; a fact becomes `resolved` only with an exact receipt/artifact at an evidence commit or an explicit human decision where the specification permits one. Documentation or rationale alone cannot resolve a normative requirement.

blocking_evidence.description: Exact reason the required evidence is unavailable; required while the fact is open.

refs.description: Exact receipt/artifact repo refs. Documentation (.md) refs cannot resolve a normative requirement. Required for receipt/artifact resolutions; a decision resolves without new refs.

reviewer.description: Human reviewer identity; required only for a decision resolution.

human.description: A decision requires an explicit human identity.

spec_permitted.description: Specification location permitting the human decision (e.g. §11.2.6 or docs/SPEC.md); required only for a decision resolution.
